You want to chroot into the system from a live cd. Just mount the partition from the live cd and chroot into the partition. Then perform the saving operations you feel you need to do as if you were on the system. Might as well look up chrooting because there are other options you can add to make your chroot better like mounting some block devices in may or may not effect you.

Back up your /boot/grub/grub.cfg to /boot/grub/grub.cfg.bak Then open grub.cfg up in your favorite editor.

  1. Find the menuentry with the 'working' 4.2.8 kernel and copy it. (make sure to copy from the menuentry not submenu)
  2. Under this line so it looks like this
  3. Delete one tab from each line so it lines up
  4. Optionally rename the menuentry
  5. reboot, it should default to the first entry, the one you copied and optionally renamed
  6. find out how to blacklist the kernel from upgrading on your distro

Resident noob here. I rented some guns today and notice I close my left eye to aim and shoot. Is that normal or should I aim with both eyes open?
Do you shoot with both eyes open?
Depends. Both eyes open when not using a magnified scope. Close one with.
Absolutely when I'm using iron sights. Unfortunately, my eyes aren't what they used to be so I need a scope for 200+ yards.
It's personal preference. It's taught to keep both eyes open so you can keep sight on a bad guy.

The key is to focus on the front sight when you have both eyes open. You should always shoot with both eyes open, as it increases your field of peripheral vision. Your target might end up looking slightly blurry or out of focus, but over time, your eyes will get used to it.
Yes. That is how I was taught.
depends on the type of shooting I'm doing. Just straight target shooting I close my non-dominate eye. When I'm training for tactical shooting both open.

Find what works for you. Hickok45 is left eyed, right handed or "cross-dominant". He holds right handed, aims with left eye. Some olympic archers have done the same. So it's really finding what works for you, what your equipment is and what type of shooting you're doing. Some people shoot with both eyes closed ;)
When shooting a pistol or shotgun I always keep both eyes open, when shooting a rifle at close range I keep them both open, at long range I tend to shut my left eye.
I always give it try at the range for a bit of practice but I'm pretty bad at it and it's not very useful beyond 200m with my eye sight.
